summary: A fault whose run has ended, which nothing at its source can close (a failed child loop run, whose outcome belongs to its parent step), can now be dismissed with a reason by a person or the fleet's fault agent: `st missions dismiss-fault RUN --reason ... --as ACTOR`. The dismissal closes that one fault (its subject and episode), drops it from `st doctor` attention-age, and records who and why; any other agent is refused, and a fault on a run that has not ended still closes only at its source

replay.detail: No replay change; current faults are still derived from their sources on each read.

schema.detail: Adds the append-only claim kind fault.dismissed (episode, reason) on fault source subjects. No database DDL or storage version change.

rules.detail: Checkpoint rules and digests are unchanged.

compatibility.detail: Adds POST /v1/faults/dismiss and `st missions dismiss-fault`. A daemon on an older build holds a replicated fault.dismissed claim until it runs this build, and keeps showing the fault until then.

downtime.detail: No startup work or expected interruption.

manual.detail: After the roll, the fleet's fault agent dismisses the faults of ended runs that cannot close (issue #4476: the failed belt pass runs) with one reason each.

recovery.detail: Rollback is forward-only once a dismissal has been written locally; older members keep fault.dismissed as a claim waiting for a newer build. A dismissal is an ordinary claim; a later failure is a new fault and is not hidden.
